name: Vision Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
By manipulating a divination magic item, you obtain access to a variety of divinatory powers.

Prerequisite(s): Vision Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Vision Mastery for every odd mythic tier you possess. By expending mythic power, you can force the item to cast a higher-level divination spell. This spell may have a level equal to 2 + 1 for every use of mythic power spent.
